Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Malkavian Prank
Each other Methuselah holds 1 to 4 counters in his or her hand. Guess the number of counters in each Methuselah's hand. If you guess correctly, you gain that much pool from his or her pool. If you guess incorrectly, that Methuselah gains that much pool from the blood bank.

Does the effect resolve one at a time after each guessing?
So basically you could sweep the table with four correct quesses.

And for trickier situations, can the metusalah playing the card decide the order which he makes the guesses?
It doesn't specify anywhere in the card and rulebooks says in "5. Master Phase" that:
"If other effects happen during your master phase, you choose the order in which these effects and your master phase actions are performed."

I think it is "yes" for both but wanted to check before I put together the silly 30 Prank deck, you know, just to get to use them all...

Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body: If in doubt/could potentially oust someone, in order of play, which ever it currently is (so usually, to the left)? Hell if I'm sure, but I'd play it that way.
